description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - karawadeniya, Ruwanwella D/S Division, Kegalle District (24-14-4-00018)
categorisation: This gazette exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the determination of land ownership for multiple parcels in Karawdeniya village under the Registration of Title Act. The content focuses entirely on land parcels, ownership details, property boundaries, and land title settlements, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There is no government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized administrative matter that would trigger any other classification type.
